text:
maria: Heads-up — Sales asks for a temporary quota bump for Acme at the conference tomorrow. They want a burst to 200 req/s for 8 hours. Details: org=acme-corp, api_key=sk-REDACTED. Can we do an allowlist / temporary uplift?
kevin: Acme is on a paid promo — they need 9am-5pm PST. They'll demo multiple integrations. If full raise isn't possible, even 4x burst helps. PLs.
tony: We have manual allow/deny tables in infra but raising per-org limits is nontrivial. Current per-org baseline is 50 rps, burst to 100 for 5m. Need an ops playbook and safety checks.
sam: There's a ‘support-elevations’ flag in routing policies we can reuse but it's internal-only. We must add TTL + audit event so it auto-reverts and we can track who enabled it.
jess: SRE note: need telemetry + cost estimate before flipping. Also put a hard circuit-breaker so if traffic >300 rps sustained we throttle and fallback to a lower-cost model.
maria: Can support do it manually if platform owners approve? Our current process is to add the org to an allowlist table and invalidate a routing cache — usually ~10m.
kevin: @tony @sam can we expose a one-off button in Console? Sales will expect near-instant turnaround.
tony: Console doesn't expose temporary raises today. We could build a "Temporary lift" button but it needs RBAC, TTL, audit logs, and a safety rollout. Not safe to ship in hours.
sam: Short-term plan: Support performs manual update with a small script that sets TTL. Long-term: add Console UX + API. Also we should prefer per-key rate caps to avoid noisy-neighboring within an org.
maria: Please post the script and confirm who is authorized to run it. We need SRE + Support sign-off.
quota-bot: ACTION: Created incident-bridge session 'temp-quota-acme' — join link: https://meet.internal/temp-quota-acme (ops-only).
jess: :thumbsup: I'll join the bridge and watch the queue. If we see >300 rps sustained I'll flip the emergency throttle.
sam: Script (pseudo):```bash
# set allowlist ttl for org
redis-cli SETEX allow:org:acme-corp 28800 200
# nudge routing cache
curl -X POST https://internal-api.local/routing/reload -H 'Authorization: Bearer <svc-token>'
```Run as k8s job using support-service account.
tony: Two policy notes: 1) do not alter global batching or model defaults. 2) tag all elevated requests with header X-Elevated: true and a billing tag so finance can track extra cost.
kevin: Sales confirms they accept cost tagging and will notify the customer.
maria: Plan: Sam to produce final script + checklist. Support will run at 08:45 PST tomorrow. Who signs off? @jess?
jess: Signed. I'll monitor latency and error budget during the window and confirm post-run. Also set a reminder to verify auto-expiry.
sam: Uploaded playbook to /internal/playbooks/temp-elevations.md (internal link). Script is staged and I'll be on call during the window.
kevin: :party_parrot: Thanks team!
_notes: Follow-up: schedule Console feature to automate this flow and add guardrails (RBAC, TTL, audit, tags).
